title: Environment Block
description: The main container for a 3D world environment. This is the root element that holds all other blocks.

threeobjecturl.description: URL to the main world model file (GLB/GLTF format)

devicetarget.description: Target device platform for rendering. Runtime default is '2D' when the attribute is absent.

scale.description: Uniform scale factor for the world model

positionx.description: X position offset for the world model. NOTE: only positiony/rotationy are read by the runtime; positionx/positionz are accepted but ignored.

positiony.description: Y position offset for the world model

positionz.description: Z position offset for the world model. NOTE: only positiony/rotationy are read by the runtime; positionx/positionz are accepted but ignored.

rotationy.description: Rotation around the Y axis (in radians)

animations.description: Comma-separated list of animation names to play

camcollisions.description: Enable camera collisions with the environment. ON unless set to '0' or 'false'.

backgroundcolor.description: Background color in hex format (e.g. #000000). The runtime also accepts the legacy spelling `bg_color`; either attribute works.

threepreviewimage.description: URL to preview image shown during loading. The alias `previewimage` is also accepted.

hdr.description: URL to HDR environment map file

hastip.description: Show (1) or hide (0) the interaction tip. Shown unless explicitly set to '0'.

zoom.description: Camera field of view in degrees for the flatscreen view.
